summary: Calc sheet protection uses the original options, document records, command state and history with verified browser and ODS behavior.
findings: The original protectSheet.py password, unlock and Cancel scenarios pass through active Calc dialogs.
Grouped history and three native verifier formats pass focused validation.
Production Chromium verifies incorrect password, unlock, and Undo.
residual_risks: Desktop zxcvbn-c strength and legacy OOXML MD5 verification remain outside the ported browser primitives. Existing size diagnostics apply outside changed paths.
